evals.prompt: F:/downloads/许老师学习方法/videos 里已经有一批 mp4，不要下载，只要把还没转写的按下载完成时间顺序转成 txt+srt。先说明你会怎么做，并问我要不要先拿最短的 1–2 个做 FunASR 预览。
evals.expected_output: Uses yj-media-transcribe creator mode: sync/ensure asr_ordered+transcribe_one, offers quality preview on shortest files, then asr_ordered.py --creator-root with mtime order; does not start MediaCrawler or download.
assertions: Mentions asr_ordered.py (or equivalent mtime-ordered ASR worker) for bulk transcription
Offers or confirms a FunASR quality preview on 1–2 short files before full run
Does not propose MediaCrawler crawl or starting a new download job
Names creator_root as F:/downloads/许老师学习方法 (or equivalent path)
Mentions both .txt and .srt outputs under transcripts/
